scope: endpoint-only encrypted MLS state with transactional continuity and durable inbox/outbox

securityReview.type: author source review, not independent cryptographic review
boundaries: scope/generation/device-bound nonextractable WebCrypto wrapping; no raw private snapshot export
version/upstream/identity/signature-private-public validation and atomic restored endpoint creation
same-transaction continuity/checkpoint compare-and-swap; losing writers cannot release wire
advanced ratchet + outgoing frames + incoming plaintext queues committed before exposing results
stable event/frame IDs and explicit transport/application acknowledgments; pending merge blocked before outgoing acknowledgment
synchronous raw endpoint ownership transfer, serialized input/roster snapshots and lock on uncertain storage/unexpected protocol failure
counter exhaustion, bounds and stale-record rejection without local reset or lost-marker fallback

limitations: Wrapping-key/device unlock and pin authority remain external verified-client prerequisites; native key cloning in fixtures is not production device assurance
No entire-profile rollback detection, copied-device prevention, stale live-sender backup restore or independent continuity witness
No private server/relay/Yjs activation, recovery/backup drill, hosted acceptance or paid infrastructure
Delivery is at-least-once with caller durability/transport acknowledgments, not independent recipient proof or exactly-once UI
No hardware/physical-erasure, full forward secrecy/PCS, independent review or E2EESA conformance claim
